BC_description: The 'Help.wrap()' method has been removed and refactored into two new methods: 'Help.formatItem()' and 'Help.boxWrap()'. This change was made to improve support for color and styling in help output, treating ANSI escape sequences as zero width during padding and wrapping. The old method is no longer available, and calls to it must be replaced.
Adaptation_method: Replace all calls to 'Help.wrap(text)' with either 'Help.formatItem(text)' or 'Help.boxWrap(text)' based on the specific use case. For general text formatting, use 'formatItem()'; for wrapping text in a boxed format, use 'boxWrap()'. Example: Before: helpInstance.wrap('some text'); After: helpInstance.formatItem('some text') or helpInstance.boxWrap('some text').
